name: Valley
description: Valley is MVRDV’s mixed-use Zuidas complex, opened in 2022. Three towers rise 67, 81 and 100 metres around an elevated public valley. Its smooth outer glass skin contrasts with jagged limestone apartments and cantilevered terraces planted by landscape designer Piet Oudolf.
